The present petition filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C. seeks quashing of FIR No. 784/2019, under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC, registered at P.S. Nangloi and all other consequential proceedings emanating therefrom, including the chargesheet pending before the court of Ms. Sonam Singh-II,
learned Metropolitan Magistrate, Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi.
opennyai_summary.facts:
2. The marriage between petitioner no.1/husband and respondent no.2/wife was solemnized on 29.01.2016 as per Hindu rites and ceremonies.
3. No child was born out of the said wedlock.
4. Due to matrimonial differences between petitioner no. 1 and respondent no. 2, the parties started residing separately from 31.08.2019.
Subsequently, respondent no.2/complainant lodged an FIR against petitioner no.1 (husband), petitioner no. 2 (father-in-law) and petitioner no. 3.
On 12.10.2021, parties arrived at a settlement and as per the said settlement deed, petitioner no.1 has agreed to pay an amount of Rs. 1,50,000/- to the respondent no.2/wife towards full and final settlement of all her claims including istridhan, permanent alimony and maintenance - present, past and future.
In the petition, it has been averred that petitioner no.1 and respondent no.2 are now divorced, the same is not disputed by respondent no.2.
opennyai_summary.final__decision:
10. In view of the settlement between the parties, learned APP for the State also has no objection if the present FIR is quashed.
12. In view of the aforesaid circumstances, and the fact that the parties have put a quietus to the dispute, no useful purpose will be served in continuing with the present FIR No. 784/2019, under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC, registered at P.S. Nangloi and all other consequential proceedings emanating therefrom, including the chargesheet pending before the court of Ms. Sonam Singh-II,

14. Petition is allowed and disposed of accordingly.
15. Pending application(s), if any, also stand disposed of.
